sources.title: vibecraft readme
sources.locator: What you can do; Requirements; Run locally; First5 minutes; Parallel work
sources.finding: Documents a local spatial agent/folder/terminal/browser workspace for Claude/Codex, source operation on macOS/Windows/Linux and parallel tasks/worktree actions. These source prerequisites are separate from binary availability.

sources.title: vibecraft src/main/services/agents/claudeCli.ts
sources.finding: Actual Claude CLI arguments request JSON/stream-json output, permission mode, optional resume ID and prompt. Binary resolves claude or Windows command path.

sources.title: vibecraft src/main/services/agents/codexCli.ts
sources.finding: Actual Codex CLI exec arguments set local repo context, JSON output, yolo and optional native resume, using installed codex binary.

sources.title: vibecraft user-docs/Mechanics/Integration/HeroMCP.md
sources.locator: What the Hero has; Recommended workflow; Practical notes
sources.finding: Documented Hero orchestrator uses product MCP layout/command operations to create agents/folders, attach workers, inspect progress and send follow-up prompts. It is enabled with MCP skills, not a claim that every workflow auto-delegates.

sources.title: vibecraft user-docs/Mechanics/Buildings/GitWorktrees.md
sources.locator: Visual creation; Sync from source; Merge to source; Conflict resolution
sources.finding: Product worktree actions create/sync/merge branches, commit worker WIP, stash source WIP, restore it and surface conflicts. Ordinary file separation is not OS containment.

sources.title: vibecraft user-docs/Mechanics/SubscriptionAccess.md
sources.finding: Docs describe a seven-day per-device trial, subscription activation/linking, modal access gate and online confirmation. No subscription amount or billing interval is published in this file.

sources.title: vibecraft src/main/services/telemetry.ts
sources.finding: Packaged non-development execution initializes PostHog only if POSTHOG_API_KEY is set. It creates a persistent install ID and sends start/install/heartbeat events. This does not establish which keys are in a released bundle.

sources.title: vibecraft src/renderer/utils/analytics.ts
sources.locator: sendEvent lines94-115; heartbeat/session state event methods
sources.finding: Renderer routes usage events to main telemetry with session ID, screen and workspace ID/name when populated. Source implements collection, so local-first operation is not proof of no telemetry.

sources.title: vibecraft LICENSE
sources.finding: Main source is Apache-2.0. The application access-service behavior is separately documented.
